_about: Indigenous Procurement Policy rules used for flags. Every value is copied from the cited official document; change a value only together with its source and retrieved date.

mandatory_set_aside.applies_to: All remote procurements, and all other procurement wholly delivered in Australia with an estimated value between $80,000 and $200,000 (GST inclusive).
does_not_apply_to: Procurements otherwise exempt from Division 2 of the Commonwealth Procurement Rules
Procurement made through a mandated coordinated procurement arrangement
mandatory_set_aside.remote_definition: Delivery point for the majority of the goods and services (by value) is in a remote area on the NIAA remote map; includes Darwin, Alice Springs, Geraldton, Kalgoorlie, Esperance, Whyalla, Port Augusta, Port Lincoln, Mt Isa and Broome.

mandatory_minimum_requirements.applies_to: Contracts wholly delivered in Australia valued at $7.5 million (GST inclusive) or more in the specified UNSPSC segments.

segments.64: Financial Instruments, Products, Contracts and Agreements
segments.70: Farming and fishing and forestry and wildlife contracting services
segments.71: Mining and oil and gas services
segments.80: Management and Business Professionals and Administrative Services
segments.81: Engineering and Research and Technology Based Services
segments.82: Editorial and design and graphic and fine art services
segments.90: Travel and food and lodging and entertainment services
segments.92: National Defence and Public Order and Security and Safety Services

eligibility.rule: From 1 July 2026 an Indigenous business must be 51 per cent or more First Nations owned and controlled, or registered with ORIC. Transition arrangements for 2026-27 also accept the original 50 per cent criterion.

exemption_16.rule: Exemption 16 of the Commonwealth Procurement Rules: procurement of goods and services from an SME that meets the IPP definition of an Indigenous enterprise.

coordinated_arrangements.rule: Non-corporate Commonwealth entities must use coordinated procurements (whole-of-government arrangements).

austender_value_basis: AusTender contract values are treated as GST inclusive for these bands; not yet confirmed against the AusTender reporting guidance.

portfolio_renames._about: Portfolios renamed by the Administrative Arrangements Order of May 2025. NIAA reports 2024-25 results under the old names and 2025-26 targets under the new ones; AGOR uses the new ones.

names.Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Deve: Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts
